summary: New York City, software developer, BA in Mathematics and Computation, DPhil in Computer Security, management consultant, interests in social media applications, Bayesian filtering, email sorting, and machine learning, family with children, experience in venture capital, frequent user of Trac and FogBugz, has worked on projects like Wildfire and POPFile, prefers OS X and Linux over Windows, critical of online anonymity, engaged in discussions about software development practices and community dynamics.
